title: Stadiums and arenas in Las Vegas, what they cost and what the public put in

rows.how: The winning bid group "would spend between $2 billion and $3 billion on the construction of a new NBA arena" (Review-Journal, one source, Nov 14 2026). No group has publicly asked the state or Clark County for money to build it; the governor's office said in March 2026 that public funding "has not been brought up" in its talks with groups
rows.label: c

rows.how: Up to $380M under SB 1 (35th Special Session, 2023): state transferable tax credits (up to $180M), Clark County bonds repaid from taxes diverted from a 9-acre sports and entertainment improvement district, and a $25M county credit; the December 2024 budget counts $350M of public sources in $1.75B; bonds issued without the election NRS 350.020 otherwise requires (sec. 34(5)(a)); referendum blocked by the Nevada Supreme Court, May 13 2024; no rent (lease sec. 4.1); the team's owner said in July 2025 that the cost was now "up in the $2 billion range" (press)
rows.label: b

rows.how: Clark County bonds and pay-as-you-go money from a new hotel-room tax (0.88% in the Strip corridor, 0.5% elsewhere in the stadium district), up to $750M under SB 1 (30th Special Session, 2016); bonds issued without the election NRS 350.020 otherwise requires (sec. 36(5)(a)); stadium owned by the Clark County Stadium Authority, no rent (lease sec. 4.1)
rows.label: b

rows.how: Built by MGM Resorts and AEG with private money; an earlier AEG plan that needed a special taxation district stalled amid county opposition
rows.label: c

note: Entered by hand from the documents named in each row (data/authorities/las_vegas_venues.csv). Allegiant Stadium's cost and public money convert to 2026 dollars at its opening year (2020) and T-Mobile Arena's at 2016; the ballpark under construction and the proposed NBA arena stay at face value. The ballpark's public figure is the cap in the 2023 law, not money paid out; the NBA arena's cost is a press report of what the winning group would spend, and no public money has been asked for.
method: select v.id, v.venue, v.team, v.league, v.status, v.year, v.cost_m, v.cost_max_m, v.public_m, v.public_basis, v.factor_2026, v.cost_2026_m, v.cost_max_2026_m, v.public_2026_m, case when v.public_m is null then null else 100 * v.public_m / v.cost_m end as public_share_pct, v.how, v.decided, v.label, coalesce((select list(s.source_id order by s.ord) from lv_sources s where s.id = v.id), []) as sources from las_vegas_venues v order by case v.league when 'NBA' then 0 else 1 end, v.year desc, v.venue
